method: Direct visual inspection of seven final Poppler96dpi rasters. Numerical geometry, colors, fields and formatting are separately asserted in the consumer receipt.

paragraph-distinct-tab-configurations.observed: Nine paragraphs visibly retain the two left positions, right and center alignment, dot/hyphen/underscore leaders, a plain gap, and repeated first alignment. No overlap or clipping.

table-minimum-height-keeps-multiline-con.observed: All four authored lines remain visible in the expanded first row. The second row visibly reserves additional height, followed by TailRow and AfterTable without clipping.

table-normalized-cell-colors-and-borders.observed: Blue and orange cell backgrounds remain distinct. InvalidFill is white with its border; PlainCell stays white with no exposed bottom/right border.

paragraph-distinct-shading-borders.observed: Red and green fills and blue/magenta borders remain distinct. PlainUnshaded is unaffected.

page-field-styled-footer.observed: The inspected second page displays the current page number2 and full title suffix in bold blue text, without truncation.

section-heading-layout.observed: Both headings align at the right edge, preserving their visible line spacing.

paragraph-rtl-indent.observed: Right-aligned paragraphs retain their shared edge; left-aligned paragraphs remain at the separate intended left indent.
